name: Metron / Research Instrument
intent: A restrained, color-vision-aware, mobile-first scientific instrument: white canvas, soft slate, scientific blue and copper. Colors reinforce visible labels, values, and position; no decorative status gradients or proprietary fonts.

cssVariables.--font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

principles: One compact instrument, not a marketing landing page
90% white and neutral; color only for meaningful data, interactive controls and keyboard focus
Blue and copper supplement explicit labels and stable chart order, never act as sole signals
Use OpenAI Sans only if already installed; otherwise system fonts. Do not ship proprietary font assets
Headless core remains independent from presentation
Immediate result, progressive disclosure, original Metron branding
No confidence theater or implied OpenAI affiliation
